Name: Okami Chibiterasu Pet
Author: DibJib
Description:
Found a request on the Mods forum for Chibiterasu (or just an Okami wolf) So I decided to take a shot at it. It replaces the dog pet with Chibiterasu. Custom Animations and sprite work.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vWsaf0O.png[/img]

The request was also for a trail of grass and flowers (I assumed pink flower petals would work) so I added in something like that in the run animation. I'd like to look into maybe swapping out the dog sounds for wolf sounds, but for now, this is what I have.
Hope it's alright!

To install, just go to your Stardew Valley content/animals folder:

Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\content\animals

And replace the dog.xnb with the downloaded one provided

[b]BACK UP THE ORIGINAL DOG[/b] by renaming the old one to dog_OLD.xnb or something similar
